description.zh-cn: 用官方 Team API Token 把 Altare 云平台接入 DeepSeek Harness：13 个工具覆盖应用、电源、部署、日志、文件、变量、备份、快照、域名与端口、Job、Schedule、团队与审计，另有 altare_api 直连任意端点。按 token scope 自动鉴权。
description.en: Connect the Altare cloud platform to DeepSeek Harness with an official team API token: 13 tools cover apps, power, deploys, logs, files, variables, backups, snapshots, domains and ports, jobs, schedules, team and audit, plus altare_api for any endpoint. Every action is gated on the token's scopes.

description.zh-cn: 通过官方 API 令牌操作 Altare 云平台权限范围内的全部能力：应用与电源、GitHub 部署与预览、日志、文件系统、环境变量、备份与快照、域名与端口、Job 与 Schedule、团队成员与审计日志。每次调用按 token scope 自动鉴权，缺权限时给出补权限的具体指引；令牌支持 dsh 凭据库、环境变量与插件配置三种来源。安装后在设置页提供「Altare 云平台管家」面板，可查看令牌来源、团队、scopes 与过期时间。
description.en: Operate everything your Altare token is allowed to: apps and power, GitHub deploys and previews, logs, the file system, variables, backups and snapshots, domains and ports, jobs and schedules, team members and the audit log. Every call is gated on the token's scopes, with actionable guidance when one is missing. Tokens come from the dsh credentials seam, the environment or plugin config. A settings panel shows the token source, team, scopes and expiry date.
